And We Bid You Good Night

ai_show_review.summary: Rare Rosemary, blazing Garcia & deep jams across two sets
ai_show_review.blurb: The Bellarmine show delivers the only known live version of "Rosemary" plus a scorching Dark Star → Saint Stephen sequence. The Other One suite and New Potato/Caboose jam showcase an intense second‑set vibe while the rhythm section holds down solid grooves throughout.
ai_show_review.review: On December 7, 1968 at Bellarmine College in Louisville, the Dead handed fans one of the most historic performances of the late‑sixties era. Garcia’s guitar is on fire, weaving volume‑knob tricks through a blistering Dark Star that segues into Saint Stephen and rolls into an unforgettable Eleven‑style jam before diving into Death Don’t Have No Mercy. The highlight for any archivist is the ultra‑rare live “Rosemary,” captured cleanly despite the tape hiss that colors all three soundboard sources. The Other One suite, bookended by twin Cryptical Envelopments, erupts with Phil’s thunderous bass and a classical‑turn feel, while New Potato/Caboose provides a loose, exploratory jam that feels like a bridge between psychedelic chaos and the mellow second set. Though the recording suffers from occasional cuts and hiss, the energy and historic significance more than compensate, making this show essential listening for Deadheads who crave both rarity and raw improvisational fire.

best_recording.reason: Best‑overall soundboard capture; despite tape hiss and minor cuts it presents the rare Rosemary and the strongest mix of the New Potato/Caboose jam and Other One suite.

key_highlights: Intense The Other One suite with thunderous bass
Exploratory New Potato/Caboose jam bridging sets
Dark Star → Saint Stephen → Eleven‑style improvisation
song_highlights: And We Bid You Good Night

band_performance.Jerry: Blazing, volume‑knob‑filled guitar work that drives Dark Star and the rare Rosemary; his solos are consistently inventive throughout.
band_performance.Phil: Thunderous bass with a classical‑turn feel during The Other One jam; adds depth to the extended improvisations.
band_performance.Mickey: Provides solid percussion backbone, keeping the groove steady even as one drummer fell ill mid‑show.
band_performance.Billy: Delivers reliable drumming alongside Mickey, anchoring both sets despite a brief disruption for equipment repairs.

must_listen_sequences: And We Bid You Good Night
